# Get4Domain

> Get4Domain is your online visible partner: a professional, industry-specific website for small and medium businesses (SMBs) in India, with the tools behind it to capture leads, take bookings and orders, send invoices and market the business. Built by KSM Quantum Technologies, Chennai, India.

## What Get4Domain does
- Gives an SMB a professional, industry-specific website (each industry gets tailored pages, records and workflows — a clinic gets appointments and patients; a restaurant gets menu and orders; real estate gets properties and site visits).
- Provides a business dashboard: CRM leads, customers, GST-compliant invoicing, accounts and reports, staff/team access.
- Includes marketing tools: WhatsApp business messaging, campaigns, and an AI Studio for content and images.
- Offers a customer portal so a business's own customers can book, order, and pay.
- Offers managed services: custom web and mobile applications, managed paid ads, social media management and content creation, quoted per project.
- Serves 20 industries: clinic/healthcare, salon, gym/fitness, coaching, education, professional services, finance, diagnostics, photography, hotel, events, travel, restaurant, retail, agriculture, automobile, construction, technology, logistics, and real estate.

## Pricing
Plans and prices are published on one page and change over time, so they are not repeated here: https://get4domain.com/pricing
- Usage-based tools (AI Studio, WhatsApp, SMS, email) are pay-per-use from a prepaid wallet.
- Managed Services are custom-quoted per project; there is no fixed price list.
- A free demo is available.

## Who it's for
Indian small and medium businesses that want a professional website and the software to run day-to-day operations, without hiring developers or stitching together multiple tools.
